Name: Bathhouse Hot Spring w Solarium Compatibility - CP
Author: Khyraen
Description:
[size=2]Use Bathhouse Hot Spring with Solarium.

[/size][b][size=4]updates[/size][/b]

[size=2]June 7, 2023 - fixed the map (tested this time).*
June 2, 2023 - fixed the issue with the maps (I think). Tile sheets reattached. (How'd that happen?)
[/size]

[size=4][b]description[/b][/size]

I just edited the entry map for the bathhouse so you can [size=3]use this with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10548?tab=description]Solarium (Rooftop Spa House)[/url] mod.[/size] There was a bush in the way and I removed it

Original authors get all the credit for these mods, which are now compatible. 

[size=4][b]The original CP Bathhouse Hot Spring mod is [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3110]here[/url][b]. [/b][/size][size=1]I suggest you use his version of the mod if you aren't running them together as it just looks better with both bushes. (That mod is itself a CP conversion of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/558]original bathhouse mod[/url].)[/size]

Again, [u]I did NOT create this mod[/u], I only edited one thing on one map for ease of use for those who don't have the time or ability to modify their mods. Credit for this mod goes to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/46300037]Nanogamer7[/url] & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/558]MiniPantsu[/url]

[s]I am not a mod'er. I just tweak mods other ppl make to make them work for me. But[/s] I'll try to include the important info.

If you want to play with BOTH mods, install my fix and Solarium and play. Don't forget to install any required mods for Solarium.

[size=1]﻿[i]You need SMAPI and Content Patcher to run this mod.

[/i][/size][font=Comic Sans MS]YOU HAVE TO TRIGGER CERTAIN EVENTS BEFORE THE SOLARIUM LADDER APPEARS. SEE THAT MOD FOR MORE INFO.[/font]

[font=Lucida Sans Unicode]You have to click on the door to get into the spa. Once the ladder is there, if you run up to the door, you might accidently trigger the warp and go up instead. It isn't super tricky, but it may happen sometimes. 

[/font]*dealing w 2 kids with health issues, so I apologize for not testing last time.
